BREAKING — Regina Robles-Reyes was arrested Tuesday afternoon, October 20, 2026, at 2:26 p.m., on a felony drug charge, according to Webb County booking records.

Robles-Reyes was booked into the Webb County Jail on one count of possession of a controlled substance, Penalty Group 2, one gram to under four grams (charge code POSS CS PG 2 ≥1G<4G) — a third-degree felony under Texas law. Bond has NOT been set.

Penalty Group 2 covers substances such as MDMA, methamphetamine in certain forms, and synthetic cannabinoids. Possessing one gram to under four grams of a PG2 substance is a third-degree felony in Texas, punishable by 2 to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

The booking record does not list an arresting agency — the holding-agency field was blank — and the records reviewed by Webb Watch 956 do not describe the alleged incident. Webb Watch 956 will follow this case as it moves through the Webb County courts.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Regina Robles-Reyes is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal.

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
